venn.comment: Read the exact lowercase detector header and its keyword boundary. venn.md#detection: Detection requires the exact lower-case prefix `venn-beta` and has no following-character boundary. venn.md#units-and-contexts: A bounded keyword is not followed by an ASCII letter, digit, or underscore.

patterns.comment: Read native comments and any preceding swallowed fragment. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 2. One UTF-16 code unit other than `}`, immediately followed by `%%`, is swallowed with the following diagram comment. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 9. Any remaining `%%`, including `%%{` that starts no common directive, starts a diagram comment through the characters before the next line feed or end.

Read a swallowed prefix separately from the comment; scope only non-whitespace as ignored text. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 2. One UTF-16 code unit other than `}`, immediately followed by `%%`, is swallowed with the following diagram comment. venn.md#comments-and-swallowed-fragments: A swallowed non-whitespace prefix is an `ignored-text` unit and a VennIgnoredText node when the remaining input is accepted. venn.md#comments-and-swallowed-fragments: A whitespace character swallowed by rule 2 is trivia and makes no node.

patterns.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Mark only a swallowed non-whitespace prefix as ignored text. venn.md#comments-and-swallowed-fragments: A swallowed non-whitespace prefix is an `ignored-text` unit and a VennIgnoredText node when the remaining input is accepted. venn.md#comments-and-swallowed-fragments: A whitespace character swallowed by rule 2 is trivia and makes no node.

Read a native diagram comment. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 9. Any remaining `%%`, including `%%{` that starts no common directive, starts a diagram comment through the characters before the next line feed or end.

Read title text after its keyword and one whitespace separator. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 12. `title`, one whitespace character of [Notation](../common.md#notation), and nonempty text without a converted `#`, line feed, or `;` make one `title-line` unit, taking as many characters as possible. common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary: A directive is trivia and not diagram text.

Keep an entity inside the surrounding text scope. common.md#entities: A directive right after the `#` or right before the `;` lies inside the entity, which is read in the text without its directives, and so do two directives right before the `;`.

Read bounded statement keywords. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 13. The bounded keywords `venn-beta`, `set`, `union`, `text`, and `style` make `header`, `set-keyword`, `union-keyword`, `text-keyword`, and `style-keyword` units respectively. venn.md#units-and-contexts: Keyword letters, including those of `title`, `rgb`, and `rgba`, are compared case-insensitively.

Read quoted and bare bracket labels. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 14. `["`, any number of characters other than `"`, and `"]` make a `quoted-label` unit. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 15. `[`, one or more characters other than `]` or `"`, and `]` make a `bare-label` unit.

Read a quoted label and its delimiters; HTML attribute quotes remain content. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 14. `["`, any number of characters other than `"`, and `"]` make a `quoted-label` unit. common.md#html-attribute-quotes: The lexer reads the two `"` of each quoted value as `'`. common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary: A directive is trivia and not diagram text. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Read quoted-label content up to its closer or a common-comment boundary. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 14. `["`, any number of characters other than `"`, and `"]` make a `quoted-label` unit. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Read a bare label and its delimiters; a closing bracket still ends the label inside a tag. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 15. `[`, one or more characters other than `]` or `"`, and `]` make a `bare-label` unit. common.md#html-attribute-quotes: The lexer reads the two `"` of each quoted value as `'`. common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary: A directive is trivia and not diagram text. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Read bare-label content up to its closer or a common-comment boundary. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 15. `[`, one or more characters other than `]` or `"`, and `]` make a `bare-label` unit. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Read a numeric size or text identifier. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 16. An optional sign followed by a decimal integer, optionally followed by a dot and one or more fractional digits, makes a `number` unit.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a whole hexadecimal color value, retaining directives. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 17. `#` and three through eight hexadecimal digits make a `hex-color` unit, taking as many digits as possible. venn.md#directives-and-ignored-semicolons: Strings, label content, title content, and whole color units are text or string units that can contain directives.
patterns.name: support.constant.property-value.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read an RGB or RGBA color value as a whole, protecting its commas and retaining directives. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 18. `rgba(`, four nonempty runs of digits or dots separated by commas, and `)` make an `rgba-color` unit. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 19. `rgb(` with three such runs and `)` makes an `rgb-color` unit. common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary: A directive is trivia and not diagram text.
patterns.name: support.constant.property-value.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a bare element name or text identifier. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 20. An ASCII letter or underscore followed by as many ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores as possible makes an `identifier` unit.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

patterns.comment: Keep an HTML tag inside the surrounding text scope. common.md#html-attribute-quotes: The lexer reads the two `"` of each quoted value as `'`.
Read a plain double-quoted name or text. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 21. `"`, any number of characters other than `"`, and `"` make a `string` unit.
Read list and value separators. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 22. `,` and `:` make the units `","` and `":"`.

venn-html-tag.comment: Read a bare-label HTML tag, leaving a closing bracket or a non-attribute quote for the enclosing label. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 15. `[`, one or more characters other than `]` or `"`, and `]` make a `bare-label` unit. common.md#html-attribute-quotes: The lexer reads the two `"` of each quoted value as `'`.

patterns.comment: Read a quoted HTML attribute value inside a bare label, leaving a closing bracket for that label. common.md#html-attribute-quotes: The lexer reads the two `"` of each quoted value as `'`. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 15. `[`, one or more characters other than `]` or `"`, and `]` make a `bare-label` unit.

venn-style.comment: Read a style statement, keeping target names separate from properties. venn.md#styles: `style` requires a nonempty target list and at least one comma-separated property.

patterns.name: variable.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a bare style target name. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 20. An ASCII letter or underscore followed by as many ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores as possible makes an `identifier` unit.

patterns.name: punctuation.separator.comma.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a target or property-list comma. venn.md#units-and-contexts: 22. `,` and `:` make the units `","` and `":"`.

venn-style-property.comment: Read a style property name and one entire value; do not scope numbers inside the value. venn.md#styles: Each property key is a bare identifier followed by a colon and a value. venn.md#styles: A style value is one complete quoted string, which may be empty, or a nonempty sequence of style atoms. venn.md#styles: Adjacent bare style atoms need no whitespace, as in `1red#abc`; the VennLiteral keeps their written spelling and spacing.

patterns.comment: Read a complete bare property value as one text run, retaining directives and protecting color commas. venn.md#styles: A style value is one complete quoted string, which may be empty, or a nonempty sequence of style atoms. venn.md#styles: Adjacent bare style atoms need no whitespace, as in `1red#abc`; the VennLiteral keeps their written spelling and spacing.
